title: ChatOff AI — User Guide

callout.p: ChatOff AI v2.2 is an offline AI assistant that answers questions using documents you upload. Everything runs on your PC — chat, PDF knowledge base, and AI models stay local.

p: Make sure these services are running on your computer before opening ChatOff:

tr.td: Database chatdb is created and schema.sql has been imported
Ollama is running in the system tray; models llama3.2:3b and nomic-embed-text are downloaded
File .env exists (copy from .env.example) with the correct database password

p: First-time install (Windows): run ChatOff_Setup.exe or setup.ps1, then launch the app from the desktop shortcut or by running python app.py.

ol.li: Open ChatOff from the desktop shortcut, Start menu, or run python app.py from the project folder.
Wait for the Login window to appear.
If you see a database error, check MySQL is running and your .env settings are correct.
On the Login screen, click Don't have an account? Sign Up.
Fill in Full Name, Username, Email Address, Password, and Confirm Password (minimum 6 characters).
Click Create Account.
When registration succeeds, return to Login and sign in with your new username and password.

callout.p: Usernames must be unique. If sign-up fails, try a different username or check that the database is available.

ol.li: Enter your Username and Password.
Click Login (or press Enter).
Regular users are taken to the Home Dashboard.
Admin users are taken to the Admin Console (Power User Console).

p: Default admin account (first install): username admin, password admin123. You will be asked to change this password on first login.
After login, you land on the Home screen with two main options:

tr.td: Open the AI chat interface to ask questions
View app version and capabilities (offline Ollama, local knowledge base)

p: Use Logout at the bottom to return to the Login screen.
h1: 6. Chat with AI — Step by Step

ol.li: From Home, click Open on the Chat & Help card.
The chat screen opens with a sidebar (left) and message area (right).
Type your question in the box at the bottom (Type a message...).
Click Send or press Enter.
While the AI works, a status line shows progress: Preparing → Searching knowledge base → Generating answer.
The reply streams in word by word. Wait until generation finishes.
To cancel mid-reply, click Stop.

p: Above the input box, quick-topic buttons may appear (based on topics your admin configured). Use them to browse categories instead of typing from scratch.

ol.li: Click a topic button to drill into sub-topics.
Use Back to return to the previous topic level.

tr.td: Click New Chat in the left sidebar
Click a session under Previous Chats
Click Home in the sidebar
Use Appearance dropdown: Dark, Light, or System

callout.p: When the answer uses your uploaded documents, the reply ends with Sources: listing the PDF or manual entry name and relevance score.

ul.li: With Sources — the AI found matching content in the knowledge base.
Without Sources — the AI answered from general knowledge (question may not match uploaded documents).

p: Admins manage the knowledge base, topics, and system health. After admin login you see the AI Command — Power User Console with this sidebar:

tr.td: Stats: document count, topics, unanswered questions
Auto-generate topic buttons from PDF text using AI
Create, edit, or delete chat topic shortcuts manually
Upload PDFs, add manual entries, view and delete sources

p: Bottom of sidebar: Appearance, Preview User Chat, and Logout.

ol.li: Click Library in the admin sidebar.
Click Upload PDF and select a PDF file from your computer.
A progress window shows reading and embedding. Wait until it completes.
The document appears in Uploaded Documents with file name, size, and upload date.
Use the Sort by dropdown to reorder (default: Newest first).

tr.td: Type or paste text directly into the knowledge base (no PDF needed)
Preview the stored text chunk for a source
Remove one document from the knowledge base
Remove all uploaded sources (use with caution)
Review questions users asked that had no good document match

callout.p: Tip: After changing the embedding model or re-uploading PDFs, ask test questions in Preview User Chat to confirm answers include the expected Sources.

ol.li: Click Topic Builder in the sidebar.
Select a PDF source to analyze.
Run the builder; AI suggests main topics and sub-topics from the document.
Review and save topics so they appear as quick buttons in user chat.
Click Manage Topic in the sidebar.
Create a new main topic or sub-topic, or edit/delete existing ones.
Saved topics appear as shortcut buttons when users open Chat.
In the admin sidebar, click Preview User Chat.
You see the same Home and Chat screens that regular users see.
Test questions against the current knowledge base.
Click Back to Admin Console to return to admin tools.
On first admin login (or when must_change_password is set), a password change dialog appears automatically.
Enter your current password and a new password, then confirm.
Log in again with the new password.

tr.td: Start MySQL; import schema.sql; check DB_PASSWORD in .env
Restart Ollama; confirm llama3.2:3b is pulled; keep model loaded with OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=30m
Normal on first question while the model loads; subsequent replies are faster
Re-upload PDFs; ask more specific questions; check Sources footer appears
Install OCR: pip install -r requirements-ocr.txt, Tesseract, and set RAG_OCR_ENABLED=true
Check username/password; admins go to Admin Console, users go to Home

ol.li: Launch app → Login
Home → Chat & Help
Type question → Send
Read answer + Sources
New Chat or Previous Chats as needed
Login as admin
Library → Upload PDF
Topic Builder / Manage Topic
Preview User Chat → test
Dashboard → monitor stats

callout.p: Version: ChatOff AI v2.2 (Offline Edition) · Local Ollama · MySQL · PDF knowledge base (RAG)
